messages:
lin: FYI runtime merged default batching/quant changes into main. Need a small relnote, migration guide updates, and snippet sweep (py & js). cc @rachel @samir
rachel: Thanks. Can someone paste the user-facing bullets? I can draft the blurb + snippets once I have them.
samir: From runtime: 1) default `batching.policy` -> "aggressive" (improves throughput for long sequences) 2) new quant profile `q8-dynmix` is available on x86-gpu images 3) legacy profiles (q4_0/q4_1) are still supported but marked deprecated.
morgan: Caveat: small-sequence latency may increase ~10-20ms in low-concurrency environments. We should call this out as a Known Issue and show opt-out options.
lin: Snippets to update: py example that did `client.generate(..., batching=None)` needs to show opt-out using `batching.policy = "none"`. Also show pinning quant profile in-call.
rachel: Draft Python snippet:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1-small", prompt=prompt, config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"})
```
rachel: I'll add JS after we agree wording.
samir: Migration doc additions: show Console/global opt-out steps, private-deploy CLI example, and how to set per-route overrides. Also link to runtime kernel-selection note (/docs/runtime/kernel-selection) and validate anchors.
docops-bot: link-check scheduled for docs repo (run id 4901).
docops-bot: link-check finished (run id 4901) — 2 broken anchors: kernel-selection.md#old-kernels should be kernel-selection.md#kernel-selection. Issue created: docs#732.
rachel: I'll update PR with py/js snippets, Known Issue blurb, and the anchor fix. Draft relnote blurb: "Default batching updated to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for long-sequence workloads. If you rely on sub-100-token latency, you may observe slightly higher tail latency; to restore prior behavior set `batching.policy: 'none'` in your client config or pin a per-route override in the Console."
samir: Looks good. Add private-deploy CLI example:```bash
redwoodctl set global-config --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1
```
morgan: Add QA reminder: run perf suite with representative sequence-length mix before flipping defaults. Also tag Dedicated ops so they can stage a canary rollout.
lin: Action items: Rachel -> update PR with py/js snippets + Known Issue; Samir -> add migration CLI + private deploy instructions; Morgan -> ops rollout notes + Dedicated handbook mention; DocOps -> resolve docs#732 and re-run link-check. I'll merge the relnote once snippets land and CI is green. :thumbsup:
